intro.text: A member of the team gathering at the Oathgate to go into Shadesmar with Adolin, who argues he should just become a Radiant to get a Shardblade.
An Iriali Stoneward bonded to the peakspren Ua'pam, who joins the diplomatic mission to the honorspren of Lasting Integrity.

items.text: When her powers appeared, Zu's people cast her out, believing her cursed rather than a Radiant. She fled to the Reshi Isles to live as she pleased, working as a guide.

In 1175 Zu joined the mission to Lasting Integrity. Before leaving, she summoned Ua'pam as a Blade to show Adolin why a Shardblade beats his swords, and on reaching Shadesmar she leapt up and hugged her spren. She deflected Adolin's questions about her past.

On the journey Zu often scouted ahead. She warned Adolin that the Tukari caravan was still following them, and cheerfully suggested they go and confront it together, until Ua'pam advised him not to encourage her.

Zu admitted she had no patience for politics and would just tell the honorspren they were being stupid. Near Lasting Integrity she disliked the plan to split up, but went back with Ua'pam and others to report to Dalinar.

appearance.text: Golden hair and bronze, almost metallic skin. She wears a chest wrap, loose flowing trousers and a thick coat, and likes her Shardblade long and slender with a wicked curve.

personality.text: Eager, excitable, blunt and playful. Zu adores her spren and ignores his calls for caution, partly just to unnerve him.
